supporting_observations.claim: The alerted HTTPS checks align with the approved RouteWise updater: routewiseupd.exe started at 13:41:16 and made a proxied connection to update.routewise.com at 13:41:18.

Subsequent connections to update.routewise.com recur at roughly five-minute intervals: 13:45:57, 13:51:18, 13:56:44, 14:01:30, and 14:06:14. The corresponding endpoint network events are attributed to routewiseupd.exe (PID 4664).
The observed destination and cadence match the inventory description of RouteWise checking update.routewise.com about every five minutes, supporting a benign explanation for the alerted activity.
The connections shown in the endpoint network events go to PROXY-COP-01 at 10.52.20.30:8080; proxy records identify the HTTPS CONNECT destination as update.routewise.com.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records show CONNECT destinations and tunnel byte counts, but the available records do not expose the HTTPS payload contents.

Endpoint network events attribute connections to routewiseupd.exe and the proxy records show the destination and timing; the logs do not provide independent remote-side confirmation of the application request.
The available records do not establish the updater executable's hash, signature, or integrity.
claims_not_established: The available evidence does not establish the contents or purpose of data exchanged inside the HTTPS tunnels.
The records do not establish whether the RouteWise executable was altered or whether its update response was authentic.
unrelated_findings: Separate review: Kim Nguyen ran Get-ADUser and WMIC and invoked SSH to 10.52.20.30:22; these are outside the alerted RouteWise connections. Records also show SQL Server process activity. Do not use these events to determine this alert. (T116-00016, T116-00018, T116-00020, T116-00022, T116-00045, T116-00055)

Separate review: Dropbox client activity and access to Dropbox are present on the workstation, although Dropbox is not among the approved services listed in the environment context. (T116-00303, T116-00306, T116-00307, T116-00318, T116-00320)

Separate review: authentication records show sara.ali credentials used from WS-KNGUYEN-01 and a resulting logon to WS-SALI-01. This is not part of the alerted outbound HTTPS activity. (T116-00115, T116-00116)
